SELECT e.event_id, e.title, e.age_limit, e.description, e.genre, e.thumbnail_url, es.event_schedule_id, es.ticket_open_at, es.event_date, v.venue_name, e.account_id as tenant_id FROM tb_event e JOIN tb_event_schedule es ON es.event_id = e.event_id JOIN tb_venue v ON es.venue_id = v.venue_id
WHERE e.event_id = #{event_id}
SELECT class_name, price FROM tb_price p JOIN tb_seat_class sc ON p.seat_class_id = sc.seat_class_id WHERE event_schedule_id = #{eventScheduleId};

SELECT #{eventScheduleId} as event_schedule_id, #{seatId} as seat_id, e.event_id, e.title as event_title, DATE_FORMAT(es.ticket_open_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as ticket_open_at, DATE_FORMAT(es.event_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as event_date, s.floor, s.row, s.col, sc.seat_class_id, sc.class_name FROM tb_seat s JOIN tb_seat_class sc ON s.seat_class_id = sc.seat_class_id JOIN tb_venue v ON s.venue_id = v.venue_id JOIN tb_event_schedule es ON es.venue_id = v.venue_id JOIN tb_event e ON es.event_id = e.event_id WHERE es.event_schedule_id = #{eventScheduleId} AND s.seat_id = #{seatId}
